message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: Sun obtained false VAT special invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) from a company, used them to deduct tax and obtain tax refund (骗取国家税款). This is the crime of 虚开增值税专用发票, used for tax evasion. The list includes "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". That is a combined label used earlier for similar cases. Also there is "经济犯" but that seems generic. In examples, for similar scenario they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". However here it's not about export tax refund, just tax deduction. The label "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" includes both export refund and deduction. It seems appropriate.

Also there is prior conviction (some other crime) but not relevant. The new crime is virtual invoice. So answer: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票

Check list: It is present exactly: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". Yes.

Thus single label.
